name: seal39
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,datetime
p=Path.cwd();excluded={'MANIFEST.json','seal39.receipt.json','seal39.output.txt'}
after=json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text());assert after['mismatches']==[]
files=[]
for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if f.is_file():
  rel=str(f.relative_to(p))
  if rel in excluded:continue
  b=f.read_bytes();files.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
receipts=[x['path'] for x in files if x['path'].endswith('.receipt.json')]
assert 'audit38.receipt.json' in receipts and 'handoff37.receipt.json' in receipts
assert all(json.loads((p/x).read_text())['exit']==0 for x in receipts)
manifest={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'files':files,'completed_runner_receipts':receipts,'terminal_self_exclusions':{'MANIFEST.json':'This manifest cannot contain its own cryptographic hash without circularity.','seal39.receipt.json':'Receipt is written only after this terminal manifest-producing child exits; excluded by exact name, not silently omitted.','seal39.output.txt':'Terminal runner stdout artifact is written after this child exits; excluded by exact name.'},'frozen_after':'frozen-after.json included by actual hash;12 checked,no mismatches','standalone_bookkeeping_receipts':['bootstrap-receipt.json','frozen-before.json','frozen-after.json'],'resource_limits':'Supplied fixed runner unchanged. All earlier runner receipts included; terminal receipt and output are explicit exclusions. No nativeCPU/RSS telemetry available. No background process launched.','credit':0,'campaign':'55/60 beyond39,94total,unchanged'}
z=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','write_lane.py','MANIFEST.json'],input=json.dumps(manifest,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
print(json.dumps({'manifest':'MANIFEST.json','sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('MANIFEST.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'files':len(files),'completed_runner_receipts':len(receipts),'terminal_self_exclusions':sorted(excluded),'frozen_mismatches':after['mismatches'],'credit':0}))
